title: Han dynasty ends as Cao Pi founds Cao Wei
summary: Emperor Xian of Han abdicated in favour of Cao Pi, who declared himself emperor of the new state of Wei. Four centuries of Han rule ended.
reason: Cao Pi's father Cao Cao had controlled the Han court for decades, and the abdication only made his family's power official.
significance: It opened the Three Kingdoms period as Liu Bei and Sun Quan claimed their own thrones.
